987.skill_description: The consolidation and review stage of behavioral therapy. Re-administer measures such as SCL-90, SDS, and SAS and compare them with pretreatment results; combine this assessment with follow-up. Reinforce learned relaxation and positive cognitions to consolidate symptom improvement and prevent relapse.

988.skill_description: During consolidation, continue reinforcing positive cognitions, self-instruction, and relaxation training. Consolidate changes such as no longer fearing social interactions and approaching exams with equanimity; strengthen confidence and adaptive capacity and support greater personality stability and maturity.

989.skill_description: Compare repeat SCL-90, SAS, and SDS results with pretreatment scores to monitor symptom reduction and functional recovery. Combine follow-up with consolidation practice to sustain reductions in anxiety and depression and improve overall psychological well-being.
